segments.t: 来源:icn ——Graptopetalum属条目 —— Graptopetalum ‘Mirinae’ 杂交种条目 翻译：种花小医杂家赵 一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。 本文感谢 @Qiuhan @duorou9 协力 Mirinae (eng. fr. kr) ‘미리내‘ 姬秋丽 This plant is known in Korea as xGraptosedum ‘Vera Higgins’ – but this name is not correct. 这种植物在韩国被称为xGraptosedum ‘Vera Higgins’——但是这个名字是错误的。 The name ‘Vera Higgins’ is a synonymous name for xGraptosedum ‘Bronze’ which is quite a different plant. (xGraptosedum ‘Bronze’.) ‘Vera Higgins’ 这个名字是姬胧月的异名，实际上姬秋丽和姬胧月是差别很大的植物。 So this plant had to be renamed. Park Seong-Jae has chosen the name 'Mirinae'     ‘미리내‘. 所以这个植物需要易名。Park Seong-Jae 选定了一个新名字，'Mirinae'  。 This is certainly a hybrid; it resembles Graptopetalum mendozae but has not the same type of rosettes and the flowers are not pure white as those of G. mendozae but have more or less tiny red dots. Vegetatively it also resembles G. pentandrum, but the petals of this species have a deep red upper half. As the flowers of ‘Mirinae’ do not show an influence either of Sedum or of Echeveria, it possibly is a Graptopetalum hybrid, maybe of the two above mentioned species. 姬秋丽显然是一个杂交种植物。它和丸叶姬秋丽（门多萨）类似，但是两者的莲座和花朵都有区别——姬秋丽的花不像丸叶姬秋丽一样是是纯白色的，而是或多或少有些红点；生长期的它也很像是 G. pentandrum（  参见站内文章： http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... &extra=page%3D1 ），但是G. pentandrum的花瓣有艳红色的上表面。且姬秋丽的花朵也没有显示出任何景天属或者是拟石莲属（基因的）影响。所以姬秋丽可能是一个风车草属的属内杂交品种。也许就是上文提到的两种植物杂交而来。 Rosettes can be up to 3cm in diameter, leaves up to 1 – 1,5 cm long and 0,5 cm wide; flowers are small, 1 cm in diameter, with 3, 4 or 5 petals. 姬秋丽的莲座最大可达到3CM直径。叶子最大有1到1.5厘米长，半厘米宽。花很小，直径1cm，有3, 4 或者5片花瓣。
